props.name: width
props.description: Width of the coordinate space the points were recorded in.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the coordinate space. The heat map keeps this aspect ratio.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — say which page and which period.

props.name: children
props.description: What was clicked: a screenshot, a wireframe, the real component. Drawn beneath the heat.

props.name: radius
props.description: Kernel radius (one standard deviation) in coordinate units. Larger blends clicks into regions.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Multiplies the heat before it is coloured; above 1, quieter areas show sooner.

props.name: showPoints
props.description: Draw each click as a dot. Controlled.

props.name: hotspots
props.description: How many hotspots to name in the summary.
